brief:
# 汪家夫妻 EP3〈等妳出門〉

## 故事前提

阿福在玄關敲錶敲到錶面裂開、翻白眼嘆氣催珍珠出門；浴室門開一條縫，珍珠只畫好一隻眼，默默把門關上鎖起來。下一格阿福還站在原地，長出拖地的白鬍子、全身蜘蛛網、頭頂鳥巢裡三隻雛鳥，窗外在下雪。他吸一口氣想再嘆，雛鳥同時瞪他。最後浴室門終於打開，一隻粉紅拖鞋踏出來——停一拍，又縮回去。

## 角色

- 阿福（afu）、珍珠（zhenzhu）：同系列定裝照。這一集珍珠只有半張化好妝的臉與一隻腳入鏡。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；集數規劃盲評 85（`docs/videos/wangjia-couple/episodes.md` 的 EP7）。採納導演建議：把「拖鞋踏出又縮回」這個最強的時機放到最後（原本的 s04、s05 對調），不加鏡、不加角色。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 14 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：等妳出門
一行說明：敲錶嘆氣 → 半邊眼妝、鎖門 → 等到白鬍子、蜘蛛網、鳥巢 → 想再嘆氣被雛鳥瞪 → 拖鞋踏出又縮回。
開場鉤子：柯基敲手錶敲到錶面裂開。

shots.ff: Medium shot of a small apartment entryway by the front door: A-Fu the Corgi himself stands upright in a brown jacket over his striped pyjamas, sneakers on, plain car keys dangling from one paw, a plain wristwatch with no numbers on his other wrist, an impatient face.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> taps the glass of his wristwatch hard again and again until a crack appears on it, rolls his eyes toward the right edge of the frame and lets out a huge sigh, his round belly sinking. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of a white bathroom door opened only a narrow crack: Zhenzhu the Shiba herself peeks out through the gap, heavy dramatic eye makeup on only her left eye, her right eye bare, a makeup brush in her paw, a blank stare.
shots.clip: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> stares through the gap without blinking, then very slowly pulls her face back and closes the bathroom door; the door clicks shut. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of the same small entryway: A-Fu the Corgi himself still stands in the same spot in his brown jacket and striped pyjamas holding the car keys out, but he has grown a long white beard reaching the floor, his whole body draped with dusty cobwebs, a cobweb strung between the keys and his ear, and three small chicks in a bird's nest on top of his head; through the window behind him snow is falling.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> stands completely still; his long white beard sways slightly; the three chicks in the nest on his head open their beaks and chirp; snowflakes drift past the window. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Close-up of A-Fu the Corgi himself with a long white beard, cobwebs hanging from his big ears, three small chicks in a bird's nest on top of his head.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> slowly draws in a huge breath, cheeks puffing, about to sigh again; the three chicks in the nest above all turn their heads down and glare at him; he freezes and swallows the breath. His mouth stays closed. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.camera: Close shot at floor level, locked
shots.ff: Close shot at floor level of a white bathroom door opening onto a hallway: a single Shiba hind paw in a fluffy pink slipper steps out onto the wooden floor; the hem of a pink floral dress at the top edge of the frame.
shots.clip: The paw in the pink slipper shown in <Picture 1> steps out onto the floor, pauses for one beat, then slowly pulls back inside, and the bathroom door gently swings shut. The camera holds a static shot.
